description: COMPLETE. Fixed five NVENC FFI struct layout bugs in SDK 12.1 that caused nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment to fail: (1) wrong H264/P4 GUIDs in NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS confirmed by runtime queries; (2) NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS.codecPicParams [u8;256]→[u8;1024]; (3) NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS.meHintCountsPerBlock [u32;2]→[u8;32]; (4) missing bufferFmt:u32 between completionEvent and pictureStruct; (5) NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM three-u32 bit-field split→single flags:u32. Added compile-time size_of assertions for NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS(1808), NV_ENC_CREATE_INPUT_BUFFER(776), NV_ENC_CREATE_BITSTREAM_BUFFER(776), NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS(2832), NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM(1544). Test passes: 1 passed 0 failed.
title: Full NVENC encode-path FFI cleanup (ISS-004)
